landing_description: Unlock the enigma. Delve into layers of knowledge, where technology intertwines with mystery. Discover the unseen. Are you ready, for a new quest?

tools_lead: Free tools for Richard Burns Rally players who use NGPCarMenu pacenotes.
tool_translator_text: Load your MyPacenotes files, pick the standard they use and the one you want, then check the call map and save the translated files.
tool_installer_text: Two real rally co-drivers for Richard Burns Rally, set up by one installer that backs up everything it changes.
installer_lead: Miłosz Matuszyk and Piotr Sieliło as your co-driver in Richard Burns Rally: the free installer, how the calls work, and how to keep your old pacenotes.
tr_lead: Convert your pacenotes between standards and configs.
tr_files_hint: From {path}. The files stay on your computer.

tr_error_no_data: The call lists couldn't be loaded. Check your connection, then choose the standards again.
tr_error_unknown: These calls name a {to} call that doesn't exist: {slots}. Fix them in the call map.
tr_drop_lead: Drag your MyPacenotes folder or .ini files here
installer_tagline: A real rally co-driver's voice for Richard Burns Rally
installer_intro: Miłosz Matuszyk and Piotr Sieliło call your pacenotes, recorded for NGPCarMenu. One installer sets it all up, and backs up what you had first.
installer_meta: Free · Windows 10+ · Richard Burns Rally with NGPCarMenu
installer_upgrade_title: Upgrade your co-driver without losing your old pacenotes
installer_upgrade_text: Pacenotes written for another co-driver? The Pacenotes Translator rewrites them for the new calls, right in your browser.
installer_voices_text: Two rally co-drivers, Miłosz Matuszyk and Piotr Sieliło, recorded for NGPCarMenu pacenotes, in better sound than the stock calls.
installer_rule_numbers: Numbers are arcs you can take on the racing line, shaped by what follows: tightens, opens, cut late.
installer_rule_hak: “Hak” is a junction of about 90°, where the racing line is hard or unwanted.
installer_rule_nawrot: “Nawrót” is a flowing turn that doubles back.
installer_rule_szpila: “Szpila” is a very tight hairpin, often taken on the spot round an obstacle.
installer_safe_text: Everything the installer changes is zipped into RBR/backup first. Download several co-drivers and switch between them later.
installer_own_title: Your own voice as the co-driver
installer_own_text: Record 30 minutes of your voice and get a high-quality, custom co-driver to use in Richard Burns Rally (and other games that work with the CrewChief app).
installer_video_text: A run with Miłosz Matuszyk's voice: PS Valstagna, tying the world record.
installer_steps_lead: The installer looks for Richard Burns Rally (RichardBurnsRally_SSE.exe) and takes you through six screens.
installer_step1_text: The first screen lists everything the installer will add.
installer_step2_text: See that the download server is reachable, and unlock private content, such as a co-driver voice of your own.
installer_step3_text: Pick the folders to change. Only Richard Burns Rally content exists for now, so you can skip the CrewChief window.
installer_step4_text: This isn't your final setup: download several co-drivers and switch between them later.
installer_step5_text: Follow the download on the fifth screen.
installer_step6_text: Choose one option in every window and save. Start the game and drive with your new co-driver.
installer_backup: Nothing is lost: before changing anything, the installer zips your current setup into RBR/backup. To go back, unzip it into the game folder.
installer_own_practice: Write your own pacenotes and practise real rally stages in full immersion.
